verdict.rationale: The product is API/agent-native by design — card enrollment, tokenization, credential retrieval, purchase-intent mandates, and passkey step-up are all documented as REST endpoints, and an official MCP server plus TypeScript agent-toolkit let AI agents invoke these same operations programmatically (visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-1/3/4/8/17/18, visa-ic-supp-3/4/5, visa-ic-probe-rt-2). However, there's no dashboard/UI described in the evidence to compare against for parity, no explicit statement that every management/back-office action (e.g., dispute resolution beyond 'signal collection', full lifecycle admin) is API-exposed, and no independent confirmation of full functional parity. Missing for 10: explicit UI feature inventory to check against, documented parity for admin/dispute/reporting functions, and independent (non-vendor) verification that API coverage is complete.
